name: VW Polo VI (AW)
note: 5-door hatchback, facelift 2021– (1.0 MPI/TSI, not GTI). L/W/H/wb agree in auto-data, autotijd and cars-data. Pre-facelift 2017–2021 differs: L 4053, wb 2551, H 1461 (ADAC manufacturer data gives H 1446 without antenna). Front and rear overhang NOT FOUND in any source (VW does not publish them; l'argus, ADAC, auto-data, autotijd, cars-data, angurten all lack them) – fo/ro null, only their sum is known (L − wb = 1522). Tracks 1525/1505 from cars-data and angurten (VW drawing); auto-data gives ranges 1500–1526 front / 1483–1509 rear depending on wheels. Wm 1964 from auto-data and ADAC.

name: Renault Clio V
note: 5-door hatchback, phase I 2019–2023. fo + wb + ro = 4050 exactly. Phase II (2023–2025) per auto-data/angurten: L 4053, fo 833, ro 637, H 1439. Tracks 1518/1506 are for 16/17-inch wheels (auto-data, autotijd); with 15-inch wheels autotijd gives 1509/1494. Wm 1988 from auto-data and angurten.

name: Peugeot 208 II
note: 5-door hatchback, petrol versions; same body for phase I (2019–2023) and phase II (2023–). fo + wb + ro = 4055 exactly; overhangs, wheelbase, tracks identical in all three sources. Width disagreement: auto-data 1745 (used), autotijd and angurten 1765 as 'without mirrors' (1765 is most likely the mirrors-folded figure); 1960 with mirrors agrees everywhere.

name: Dacia Sandero III
note: Standard Sandero hatchback (not Stepway), 2020–2025 before the 2025 facelift (facelift per auto-data: L 4102, W 1853). fo + wb + ro = 4089 vs L 4088 (1 mm rounding; autotijd gives ro 665). Width 1848 / 2007 with mirrors from auto-data and angurten; autotijd lists 1753 without mirrors, which contradicts the other two and was not used. Stepway differs (L 4099, fo 830, H 1587).

name: Hyundai i20 III (BC3)
note: 5-door hatchback, facelift 2023– (not N / N Line). fo + wb + ro = 4065 exactly; L/W/H/wb/fo/ro agree in auto-data and autotijd. Pre-facelift 2020–2023 is L 4040 with the same wheelbase; its overhangs were not found in a consistent form (angurten lists 815/650, which sums to 4045 and matches neither length) – do not use these for the facelift. Tracks 1545/1549 are for 15-inch wheels from auto-data only (16/17-inch: 1539/1543 and 1531/1536). Width with mirrors not published – Wm null.

name: Opel Corsa F
note: 5-door hatchback, 2019–2023 body (facelift 2023– is L 4061 / fo 832 per auto-data, otherwise the same). fo + wb + ro = 4060 exactly; overhangs agree in auto-data, autotijd and angurten. UNCERTAIN tracks: auto-data gives 1501/1500, autotijd and angurten give 1489/1488 (probably a different wheel/offset); the sister car Peugeot 208 has 1500/1500. Height 1435 (auto-data petrol/diesel, autotijd 2023–) vs 1433 (electric and autotijd 2020–2023).

name: Suzuki Swift (2024, A2L)
note: European 5-door, front-wheel drive, 1.2 mild hybrid. L/W/H/wb from the official Suzuki Germany press release (3860 / 1735 / 1495 / 2450; Allgrip 4WD H 1520), confirmed by autotijd and ADAC. Japanese-market car is narrower (1695) – do not mix. Front and rear overhang NOT FOUND in any source – fo/ro null (L − wb = 1410). Tracks 1530/1530 with 175/65 R15 from autotijd only; versions on 185/55 R16 are listed as 1515/1520 with H 1485 (angurten, ADAC). Wm 1875 from ADAC manufacturer data only.

name: Ford Focus IV hatchback
note: 5-door hatchback, facelift 2022–2025, base bumper (not ST-Line/ST/Active). fo + wb + ro = 4382 exactly; L/W/H/wb/fo/ro agree in auto-data and autotijd. Pre-facelift 2018–2021: L 4378, fo 909, ro 769 (auto-data). ST-Line/ST bumper: L 4392–4393, ro 779–780. Tracks 1572/1553 come from the pre-facelift auto-data listing only (same chassis; facelift base listing has no tracks) – single source.

name: Hyundai i30 III hatchback (PD)
note: 5-door hatchback (not Fastback, not N). Outer dimensions unchanged across the 2019/2020/2024 facelifts. fo + wb + ro = 4340 exactly; overhangs and tracks agree in auto-data and angurten, L/W/H/wb also in autotijd. Tracks 1559/1567 are for 17-inch wheels; with 15-inch wheels auto-data gives 1573/1581. Width with mirrors not published – Wm null.

name: Toyota Corolla hatchback (E210)
note: European 5-door hatchback, hybrid. All of L/W/H/wb/fo/ro/tracks/tyre are from the official Toyota UK technical specification sheet (2021 and 2025 editions identical) and match auto-data, autotijd and angurten. fo + wb + ro = 4370 exactly. Tracks are the same for 16/17/18-inch wheels. Wm 2090 is from one auto-data listing only (not in the Toyota sheet). GR Corolla / US hatchback are different (wider, longer) – not used.

name: Renault Megane IV hatchback
note: 5-door hatchback, standard versions (not R.S.: L 4364–4372, W 1874–1875, wider tracks). fo + wb + ro = 4359 exactly; all values agree in auto-data and autotijd. angurten lists slightly different tracks (1584/1587) and H 1438. Wm 2058 from auto-data only. auto-data's phase II (2020–) listing shows L 4358 / fo 918, i.e. within 1 mm.

name: Peugeot 308 III hatchback
note: 5-door hatchback (not SW), phase I 2021–2025; phase II (2025–) keeps L 4367 / W 1852 per auto-data. fo + wb + ro = 4367 exactly; overhangs agree in all three sources. Height 1444 is the petrol/diesel figure (autotijd); plug-in hybrid and e-308 are 1441. Rear track 1554 (auto-data, angurten) vs 1553 (autotijd).

name: Mazda 3 hatchback (BP)
note: 5-door hatchback. L/W/Wm/H/wb/tracks/tyre from the official Mazda Germany press document 'Mazda3 2027 – Technische Daten' (205/60 R16 on Prime-Line, 215/45 R18 on higher trims; dimensions identical), matching autotijd and angurten. Front and rear overhang NOT FOUND: the official sheet does not list them and no other source had them (Mazda EU/UK press archives need a login) – fo/ro null (L − wb = 1735).

name: Seat Leon IV hatchback (KL)
note: 5-door hatchback (not Sportstourer). fo + wb + ro = 4369 vs L 4368 (1 mm rounding); overhangs agree in auto-data and autotijd. Width 1800 (auto-data, angurten) vs 1799 (autotijd). Tracks 1545/1516 from auto-data and angurten, where they are quoted for 195/65 R15 ET45 wheels (auto-data range 1534–1545 front); autotijd gives 1550/1520. FR versions sit lower (H 1442).

name: BMW 3 Series sedan (G20)
note: Sedan, pre-LCI 2019–2022, rear-wheel drive, standard bumper (not M Sport/M340i: L 4713–4717). fo + wb + ro = 4709 exactly; all values agree in auto-data, autotijd and angurten (BMW drawing). Height 1435 for 318i/320i, 1442 for 330i and diesels. xDrive tracks are 1573/1587–1567. LCI 2022– is L 4713 with fo 803 / ro 1059 (auto-data only).

name: Mercedes C-Class sedan (W206)
note: Sedan with the standard (Avantgarde) bumper, L 4751; L/W/Wm/wb agree in auto-data, autotijd and angurten. UNCERTAIN overhangs: 800 / 1086 are from auto-data only (sum with wb = 4751 exactly; autotijd shows an 800 front overhang only on the All-Terrain estate, L 4755, so there is no second source for the sedan). The AMG Line bumper car is L 4793 with fo 835 / ro 1093 (autotijd and angurten, taken from the Mercedes C 200 drawing; 835 + 2865 + 1093 = 4793) – use that set instead if modelling AMG Line. UNCERTAIN tracks: 1590/1579 from autotijd and angurten (Mercedes drawing); auto-data gives 1582–1601 front / 1594–1613 rear depending on wheels. Height 1438 from auto-data (1437–1442 by engine); autotijd/angurten say 1446.

name: Audi A4 sedan (B9)
note: Sedan, facelift 2019–2024, standard bumper (not S line/S4). L/W/H/wb/tracks agree in auto-data and autotijd. Overhangs 899 / 1043 for the facelift are from auto-data only (all 21 listings identical; fo + wb + ro = 4762 exactly) – single source. The pre-facelift 2015–2019 body is confirmed by two sources (auto-data and angurten, Audi drawing): L 4726, W 1842, H 1427, wb 2820, fo 880, ro 1026, same tracks and Wm 2022 – use that set if a doubly verified overhang is required.

name: Toyota Corolla sedan (E210)
note: European 4-door sedan ('Saloon' column of the official Toyota UK technical specification sheet, 1.8 hybrid). fo + wb + ro = 4630 exactly; L/W/H/wb/fo/ro match auto-data and autotijd. Rear track 1539 is with 16-inch wheels (1544 with 17/18-inch). Width with mirrors not published – Wm null. Non-European sedans (L 4651, W 1775) are a different body – not used.

name: Toyota Camry (XV70)
note: European Camry Hybrid 2.5 (sold in Europe 2019–2024). All values from the official Toyota UK technical specification sheet and identical in autotijd; fo + wb + ro = 4885 exactly. Tracks 1590/1615 are with 17-inch wheels (18-inch: 1580/1605). Width with mirrors not published – Wm null. US-market sedans are 4879–4895 long depending on trim – not used.

name: VW Arteon fastback
note: 5-door fastback (not Shooting Brake). L/W/H/wb/tracks agree in auto-data and autotijd; the 2020 facelift is listed as L 4866 by auto-data, autotijd keeps 4862. Front and rear overhang NOT FOUND for the fastback – fo/ro null (L − wb = 2025). autotijd lists 902 / 1118 for the Shooting Brake, but that pair does not sum to its length (4857 vs 4866), so it was not carried over. Wm 2127 from auto-data; angurten says 2090 and wb 2841 (disagreement).

name: Mazda 6 sedan (GJ/GL)
note: 4-door sedan, European 2018 facelift (2018–2024). L 4870 / W 1840 / Wm 2090 / H 1450 / wb 2830 from ADAC manufacturer data and auto-data; cars-data and the 2012–2015 car give L 4865, US-market cars 4895. Front and rear overhang NOT FOUND in any source (Mazda press archive for the Mazda6 needs a login) – fo/ro null (L − wb = 2040). Tracks 1585/1575 are with 225/55 R17 (cars-data; auto-data range 1585–1595 / 1575–1585); with 225/45 R19 they are 1595/1585.
